title: Rock Tracker
description: Contract for the Rock Tracker workbook. Leads type only on rock tabs (one per rock, laid out by rock_tab). Consolidated sheets (kind consolidated) stack every rock tab with one Excel 365 dynamic array formula each and are what the portal and the email read. History sheets (kind history) are Excel Tables appended by scripts/office/snapshot.ts. Lookup sheets (kind lookup) are Excel Tables seeded from 'seed'. Sample rows live in data/sample.json. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/DECISIONS.md 0002 and 0010 to 0016 (change request 1).

migration.v2_2_to_v2_3: 2.2 to 2.3 copies everything as is. New calculated Milestones column QuarterAhead, new Rocks strip columns ThirdMCQuarter and FourthMCQuarter and new params HorizonEnd, ThirdMCQuarter, FourthMCQuarter are all formulas, so no input column changes. Visible now also shows milestones in the 3rd and 4th MC quarter.
migration.v2_1_to_v2_2: 2.1 to 2.2 copies everything as is. The new Milestones input column Progress starts empty (ProgressShown is calculated, so Completed milestones show 100 straight away). No lookup or history change.
migration.live_data: None expected: the v1 workbook was not deployed (PLAN T13 and T19 open). The mapping below is what `--from` does if a v1 file was loaded early.
rock_tab: Fields UpdateDate, State, MainMessage and all section 7 profile fields: copied by name to their new rows.
PositionsPlanned and PositionsFilled: copied into Teams slot 1 as TeamName 'Team (migrated)', Budgeted and Actual; the lead renames or splits it.

Epics block slot n becomes Milestones block slot n (same slot, so R03-E04 becomes R03-M04): Title, ADOId, Commitment, PlannedDate, ForecastDate, Comment, KRLink by name. LeadStatus On hold and On watch copied; LeadStatus value Delivered becomes Completed and ActualDate = ForecastDate when one is set. New columns (Owner, StartDate, Description, Detail1 to Detail3, ADOLink) start empty.
Risks: TopRisk dropped. The titles of up to 3 open risks with TopRisk Yes are copied into Attention1 to Attention3 in slot order.
CallOuts and Decisions: copied by name, same slots.
history: EpicSnapshots rows become MilestoneSnapshots rows: EpicKey renamed MilestoneKey with -E replaced by -M (also inside SnapshotID); ActualDate empty; MCQuarter computed from ForecastDate, else PlannedDate.

RockSnapshots: EpicsCommitted, EpicsSlipped, EpicsDelivered renamed MilestonesCommitted, MilestonesSlipped, MilestonesCompleted; PositionsPlanned and PositionsFilled renamed PositionsBudgeted and PositionsActual.
lookups: lkp_EpicStatus renamed lkp_MilestoneStatus with Delivered renamed Completed (seed only, nothing typed). lkp_LeadStatus value Delivered renamed Completed. lkp_People, lkp_ValueChains, lkp_Steercos copied as is.

params.name: HighRiskMin
params.meaning: A risk is High when likelihood score times impact score is 6 or more (6 or 9 on the 3 by 3 grid).

params.name: StaleDays
params.meaning: A rock is stale when its update date is more than 14 days old (G1).

params.name: MCQuarterStart
params.meaning: First day of the current MC quarter. MC quarters start on the same days as calendar quarters; only the label differs (MC year starts in April).

params.name: MCQuarterEnd
params.meaning: Last day of the current MC quarter.

params.name: OutlookEnd
params.meaning: Last day of the next MC quarter. The outlook runs from MCQuarterStart to OutlookEnd: the current MC quarter plus the next one.

params.name: CurrentMCQuarter
params.meaning: Label of the current MC quarter, for example MC26Q3 for October to December 2026.

params.name: NextMCQuarter
params.meaning: Label of the next MC quarter, for example MC26Q4 for January to March 2027.

params.name: ThirdMCQuarter
params.meaning: Label of the third MC quarter counted from the current one, for example MC27Q1 for April to June 2027.

params.name: FourthMCQuarter
params.meaning: Label of the fourth MC quarter counted from the current one, for example MC27Q2 for July to September 2027.

params.name: HorizonEnd
params.meaning: Last day of the fourth MC quarter (the current quarter counts as 1). The roadmap horizon runs from MCQuarterStart to HorizonEnd; the outlook for signals stays at OutlookEnd.

params.name: NextSteerco
params.meaning: Earliest steerco date in lkp_Steercos on or after today; 0 when none is listed.

update_guide: Your update, top to bottom on your rock tab only. Aim for 7 minutes per rock.

1. Update: set Update date to today (Ctrl+; types today), check State, rewrite Main message only if it changed, keep the 3 key risks or attention points current (one line each). The grey lines below them show the open decision requests from section 6.
2. Look at Signals (grey, calculated). If the data signal is worse than your State, either fix the data or say why in the main message.

3. Milestones: change Forecast date and Comment only where they moved. When a milestone is done, set Lead status to Completed and type the Actual date. Set Lead status to On hold or On watch when it applies; leave it empty otherwise. Progress %, a whole number from 0 to 100, is optional; Completed always shows 100%.
4. Risks: change only risks that changed. Closed risks: set Status to Closed.
5. Call outs: add new ones, set Status to Closed when done.

6. Decisions: add a row for each decision you need from steerco, one line each. After steerco, fill in Outcome, Owner and Follow up on the same row, and set commitment levels on your milestones. Never clear a decided row: it is the decision log.
7. Teams: change Budgeted or Actual only when a position is added, filled or left.
Everything else carries over: values stay in place until you change them. Grey cells are calculated; never type in them.
add_rock: Add a rock (workbook owner, about 10 minutes):
1. Make sure the lead, the GPM and the value chain exist in lkp_People and lkp_ValueChains.
2. Right click the RockTemplate tab, Duplicate. Check the copy sits between RockTemplate and RocksEnd.
3. Rename the copy to a short name, for example R07 Checkout.
4. In section 7 Rock profile, fill in a new Rock ID (R plus two digits, never reused), name, value chain, lead, GPM, purpose, goals, what it delivers. Active is Yes.
5. Ask the lead to fill in sections 1, 3 to 6 and 8. The portal shows the rock after its next refresh; nothing changes in the portal.
close_rock: Close a rock: set Active to No in section 7. Its milestones, risks, call outs and teams leave the portal; its decisions stay in the decision log. Never delete the tab.

rules: Type only on rock tabs, in the white cells. Grey cells are calculated. Never type on Rocks, Milestones, Risks, CallOuts, Decisions, Teams or the snapshot sheets.
Never insert or delete rows or columns on a rock tab, and never move a rock tab outside RockTemplate and RocksEnd.
Never reuse a Rock ID. Never rename RockTemplate, RocksEnd or any sheet other than a rock tab.
Pink cells are required and still empty.
Structure changes go through the factory repository (schema change, rebuild, migrate).

definitions.meaning: All committed milestones are forecast on or before their planned date and no High risk is without an action
definitions.exit: Moves to At risk as soon as one of those stops being true

definitions.meaning: At least one committed milestone is slipping or a High risk is open, and the lead believes it is recoverable this quarter
definitions.exit: Back to On track when forecasts are back on plan; to Off track when not recoverable without a steerco decision

definitions.meaning: Commitments for this quarter will be missed without a steerco decision (scope, date or people)
definitions.exit: Leaves only after steerco has decided and the plan is re baselined

definitions.meaning: Done. Set by the lead (Lead status Completed); type the Actual date too.
Paused by decision. Set by the lead (Lead status).
Calculated: commitment is Choice point or Not committed (or empty), and not Completed or On hold.
Calculated: committed, and forecast date later than planned date.
Committed, forecast still on plan, but the lead flags a concern (Lead status On watch).
Calculated default: committed, forecast on or before planned date (or no forecast yet), no flag.
When work on the milestone starts or started.
The date steerco committed to. Changes only when steerco re baselines.
The lead's current best estimate; the date leads update. Empty means on the planned date.
The date the milestone was completed. Optional and recorded only: Lead status Completed is what makes it Completed. When filled in it is the timeline date.

Company quarter; the MC year starts in April. MC26Q3 is October to December 2026, MC26Q4 is January to March 2027, MC27Q1 is April to June 2027. A milestone's MC quarter follows its Actual date when filled in, else its Forecast date, else its Planned date.
The current MC quarter plus the next one. Counts (x of y) use milestones with a planned or timeline date in the outlook.

A milestone shows on the roadmap when it falls in the outlook, has no date yet, or is not Completed and its date has passed (overdue). A Completed milestone whose actual date (or, when empty, planned date) is before today drops out.
Steerco has agreed to deliver this milestone by its planned date.

A decision (scope, date, funding or people) is needed before it can be committed. Raise it as a decision with Choice point Yes and a decide by date; that decision row is what the portal shows on tab 3.1. Set the milestone commitment to Choice point too; the About sheet flags rocks where the two disagree.
A known future need on the horizon, with no promise of date or scope.
Very likely to impact the timeline: likelihood score times impact score is 6 or 9 (Low 1, Medium 2, High 3).
Up to three one line points the lead wants steerco to see on tab 1. Free text; they replace the old Top risk flag.
Actual positions divided by budgeted positions, per team and summed over the rock's teams.

Off track when a committed milestone planned this MC quarter is forecast after its end; At risk when a committed milestone in the outlook slipped, a committed milestone is overdue, or a High risk has no key action or owner; otherwise On track. Shown next to the lead's State; the lead's State is what counts.

rock_tab.end_sheet_note: Rock tabs live between RockTemplate and RocksEnd. Do not move, rename or delete this tab.
rock_tab.protect: Rock tabs, consolidated sheets and snapshot sheets are protected without a password: entry cells unlocked, no row or column insert or delete. Protection is a guard rail, not security.
rock_tab.title_formula: =IF({RockID}="","New rock: fill in section 7 Rock profile first",{RockID}&" · "&{RockName})
rock_tab.guide_text: Update top to bottom in about 7 minutes: 1 Update and key points, 2 check Signals, 3 Milestones that moved, 4 Risks that changed, 5 Call outs, 6 Decisions, 7 Teams when they change. White cells are yours; grey cells are calculated.

formula_syntax.[Column]: the cell of that column in the same block, same row (relative)
formula_syntax.{Field}: the absolute address of a single rock tab field (sections Update, Signals, Profile)
formula_syntax.{Block.Column}: the absolute range of that block column over all its slot rows
formula_syntax.{slot}: the 1 based slot number of the row inside its block
formula_syntax.names: params (HighRiskMin, StaleDays, MCQuarterStart, MCQuarterEnd, OutlookEnd, CurrentMCQuarter, NextMCQuarter, ThirdMCQuarter, FourthMCQuarter, HorizonEnd, NextSteerco) and lookup lists lst_lkp_<sheet>_<column> are workbook defined names
formula_syntax.number_format: optional on a column or field: the Excel number format of its cells (for example 0% on FillPct); dates always use d mmm yyyy
formula_syntax.format: optional on a typed column: url means data validation that the cell is empty or starts with https://

consolidation_formula.note: Header row 1 is static text; the formula in A2 spills all rows. Empty cells arrive as 0 through VSTACK, hence ISTEXT on the key and the zero to blank wrap on list blocks. Sheets with keep_zero_columns (Teams: Budgeted, Actual, FillPct) skip the wrap on those columns so a real 0 stays 0 (DECISIONS 0018); an empty count cell then shows 0. The Rocks strip already returns "" for blanks and holds real zero counts, so it is not wrapped.

sheets.purpose: Every milestone of every active rock: commitment, dates, derived status, MC quarter and outlook flags. Read only, stacked from section 3 of every rock tab

columns.name: MilestoneKey
columns.label: Key
columns.rule: RockID-M plus the two digit slot number; empty when the row has no title, the rock has no ID or the rock is not active. A slot is one milestone for life.

columns.name: Owner
columns.label: Owner
columns.read_by: roadmap list and milestone pop up (tab 3), email per rock section

columns.name: ActualDate
columns.label: Actual date (when completed)
columns.read_by: TimelineDate, MCQuarter, Visible, pop up; email releases this period

columns.name: Progress
columns.label: Progress %
columns.read_by: ProgressShown (progress bar on the roadmap list and in the pop up)

columns.name: ProgressShown
columns.label: Progress shown
columns.rule: 100 when Status is Completed (whatever Progress holds), else the typed Progress; empty when Progress is empty. The portal reads this column for the progress bar. A typed 0 stays 0 on the consolidated sheet (keep_zero_columns).

columns.name: Status
columns.label: Status
columns.rule: First match wins: Lead status Completed gives Completed; Lead status On hold; Commitment not Committed (or empty) gives Not committed; Forecast later than Planned gives Slipped; Lead status On watch; otherwise On plan. Slipped overrides On watch.

columns.name: SlipWeeks
columns.label: Slip (weeks)
columns.rule: (Forecast minus Planned) / 7, one decimal, only when Slipped.

columns.name: SlipSeverity
columns.label: Slip severity
columns.rule: Only for Slipped milestones: Major when the MC quarter of the forecast date is later than the MC quarter of the planned date, Minor when the forecast stays in the same quarter. Empty otherwise. The portal colours the slip extension crimson for Major and amber for Minor.

columns.name: TimelineDate
columns.label: Timeline date (actual, else forecast, else planned)
columns.rule: Actual date when filled in, else Forecast date, else Planned date; empty when none is set. The date the roadmap draws the milestone at.

columns.name: MCQuarter
columns.label: MC quarter
columns.rule: MC quarter of TimelineDate: shift the date back 3 months, then MC, the two digit year and Q with the quarter. October 2026 is MC26Q3, January 2027 MC26Q4, April 2027 MC27Q1. Empty when there is no date. No TEXT year format, so it works in every Excel language.

columns.name: QuarterAhead
columns.label: Quarter ahead (1 to 4)
columns.rule: MC quarter offset of TimelineDate counted from the current quarter: 1 current, 2 next, 3, 4. An Overdue milestone from an earlier quarter is 1. Empty when there is no date, the date is after HorizonEnd, or the date is in an earlier quarter and the milestone is not Overdue. The portal horizon selector only filters on this column.

columns.name: InOutlook
columns.label: In outlook (this and next MC quarter)
columns.rule: Yes when the planned date or the timeline date falls between MCQuarterStart and OutlookEnd. Drives the x of y counts and the data signal.

columns.name: Visible
columns.label: Shown in the portal
columns.rule: No when Completed and the actual date (or, when empty, the planned date) is before today. Otherwise Yes when there is no date (Not dated yet list) or QuarterAhead is 1 to 4; otherwise No (beyond HorizonEnd, or an earlier quarter that is not Overdue). The roadmap tab reads Visible Yes and filters the horizon on QuarterAhead. InOutlook, the signals and the x of y counts stay on the two quarter outlook.

columns.name: Overdue
columns.label: Overdue
columns.rule: Committed, not Completed or On hold, and the timeline date (forecast, else planned) is before today.
